blockers: No staging environment. railway status --json reports one environment, production. Creating a second with its own database is a billing action for the account owner.

Production deploys on a merge to main, and this branch is 72 commits and 1,426 files ahead of it, of which 16 are this work. Merging would ship the September corpus revamp to a live medical-evidence site. The release path is the owner's decision; docs/dossier-v4-production-runbook.md sets out both.

main carries 26 migrations and this branch carries 36. Ten would replay against a production database whose state cannot be verified from here; the live deployment is from 2026-09-04 and predates all of them.

reviewed_claims is empty for every medicine, so enabling the compass would publish 6,896 preliminary pages and 3,351 limited ones. They say so honestly, which is correct behaviour and not a reason to publish them at scale.

feature_flags.DOSSIER_V4_SLUGS: unset in production; the compass and review are inert until it is set
feature_flags.DOSSIER_COMMUNITY_REVIEW: unset follows the compass; off withdraws review; on keeps it if the compass is rolled back
feature_flags.DOSSIER_REVIEW_PROPOSALS: off stops new proposals, leaves the ones in flight reviewable
feature_flags.DOSSIER_REVIEW_DECISIONS: off stops decisions, leaves the queue readable
feature_flags.DOSSIER_REVIEW_AUTOPUBLISH: off records approvals and freezes the pointer; a steward releases with POST /api/page-statements/proposals/<id>/publish
